labels.anchor_text: It is our aim to share this panel with a recognized repository
labels.rationale: The three central reagents of the paper have no RRID and no repository accession. The paper directs the reader to contact the authors. The blocking test in the annotation prompt asks whether someone must email the authors, and here the paper says so in writing. Note that this defect is not a reporting failure: a newly established line cannot have an accession at first publication. The commercial lines pass this field cleanly with ATCC and AddexBio catalogue numbers. See AMB-113.

labels.anchor_text: All cells in culture were routinely screened for mycoplasma contamination
labels.anchor_section: 2.5 DNA Extraction, Genotyping and Check for Mycoplasma Contamination
labels.rationale: The field type is boolean. The paper reports that screening happened and never reports the result. The word routinely also gives no frequency. Non-blocking per the pack note: this is documentation debt and does not stop execution. See AMB-114.

labels.anchor_text: DNA was collected in the initial passages for each cell line
labels.anchor_section: 2.5 DNA Extraction, Genotyping and Check for Mycoplasma Contamination
labels.rationale: Initial passages, low passages and distinct passages appear, and no passage number appears anywhere. This would be minor for an immortalised line. It is not minor here: these are conditionally reprogrammed primary lines that stop growing after 56, 102 and 70 days and after 8, 37 and 20 cumulative population doublings. The high-throughput screen ran on SSA-PC01, the shortest lived of the three. A replicator cannot tell where in that lifespan the reported IC50 values sit.

labels.anchor_text: A total of 10 concentrations whose range depended on the individual results obtained in the validation were tested (reported in Supplementary Table S2)
labels.rationale: The concentration ranges for the IC50 assay, which produces Figure 6D and the main claim of the paper, are deferred to Supplementary Table S2. The Supplementary Materials list describes Table S2 as cell viability for the 1280 compounds in the primary screen. The pointer and the described content do not agree, so the deferral target is probably wrong. Confidence is medium because the supplement was not supplied and may still hold the values. See AMB-115.

labels.anchor_text: there was an overnight incubation with the primary antibody
labels.rationale: Overnight appears twice, for primary antibody incubation and for the pre-wound medium change. It is a relative condition, not a value, and covers roughly 12 to 18 hours. Non-blocking because the immunofluorescence readouts here are qualitative presence calls, except Ki67, which is counted as a percentage of a large field. Every other duration in the paper is given as a number.

labels.anchor_text: The final conditioned medium is made of three parts of this filtered medium mixed with one part of F medium
labels.anchor_section: 2.2 Feeder Cell Culture, Irradiation and Conditioned Medium
labels.rationale: This is the known blocking class from the earlier batch: a ratio of an in-house conditioned medium standing in for a concentration. The active content depends on the feeder batch, the confluency at collection, the irradiation outcome and the 72 h collection window. A 3:1 ratio is not transferable between labs. The base F medium by contrast is fully specified with concentrations for all seven components, so the defect is confined to the conditioned fraction.

labels.anchor_section: 2.3 Isolation of Primary Cells and Propagation by Conditional Reprogramming
labels.rationale: No trypsin concentration and no vendor for the step that separates feeder cells from epithelial cells. Trypsin strength changes the timing directly. Marked non-blocking because the paper gives an observational endpoint instead of a parameter: the operator watches the feeder cells detach under a bright-field microscope. That endpoint is self-correcting across a range of trypsin strengths. See AMB-117.

labels.anchor_text: by PCR using the primer set MGSO/GPO1 and conditions from [42]
labels.anchor_section: 2.5 DNA Extraction, Genotyping and Check for Mycoplasma Contamination
labels.rationale: The conditions are deferred to a 1992 paper with no parameters carried forward. Non-blocking because the primer set is named, mycoplasma screening is not a reported result of this study, and the deferral target is a specific and retrievable methods paper rather than a chained prose citation.

labels.anchor_text: Multiple metaphases were evaluated per sample.
labels.rationale: No metaphase count is given, and the count is what supports the claim of a normal karyotype in a cancer-derived line. Marked non-blocking because ISCN convention sets 20 metaphases and a cytogenetics lab would apply it without asking. Marked low confidence because this rests on a general prior about the field, and because a reviewer challenging the normal karyotype claim would need the number.

labels.anchor_text: Representative images of the wound closure
labels.rationale: The paper is unusually explicit elsewhere on this field: the primary screen states single well per plate without technical or biological replicates, and the IC50 assay states three biological replicates. The wound healing assay states no n at all. The word representative implies more than one and gives no number. Closure times of 11 h 30 min against 14 h 20 min are compared across cell lines in the Discussion, and that comparison cannot be assessed without n.

labels.anchor_text: The Welch t-test was applied to compare the IC50 mean values of commercial vs. established PC cell lines
labels.rationale: The test is named, the software is versioned, and the curve-fitting model is named as four-parameter logistic. But the reported values are adjusted p-values and the adjustment method is never stated. With five or six comparisons the choice of method decides whether the camptothecin result at 0.009966 and the pyrvinium result at 0.064233 fall on the same side of a threshold. The adjusted values cannot be recomputed.
